name: 맞게 하다 / 잘못 하다 / 잘 못하다 : 영어로 말하기

keywords.en: I might have misheard the meeting time.
keywords.ko: 자주 쓰는 단어: mishear(잘못 듣다), misread(잘못 읽다/해석하다), misspell(철자를 틀리다), misplace(물건을 잘못 두다)
bold_words: I might have misheard the meeting time.

keywords.en: I completely misread the instructions.

keywords.ko: (차 키를 어디 잘못 둔 것 같아.)

my_sentences.en: didn't [RV] right / correctly
my_sentences.ko: 하려던 대상은 맞지만, '행위의 방식이나 과정이 올바르지 않았을 때(오류/미숙)' 씁니다. 한국어의 띄어쓰기 "잘 못했다(능숙하지 못함/제대로 안 됨)"에 가깝습니다.
bold_words: didn't [RV]  right / correctly

my_sentences.en: I didn't plug it in right.
bold_words: I didn't plug it in right.

my_sentences.en: The computer crashed because I didn't save the file right.

bold_words: I didn't hear you right. Could you say that again?

bold_words: I didn't follow the recipe right, so it tastes weird.

my_sentences.en: [RV] + [O] + wrong
